turns.content:
Build a multi-page website for "Artisan Goods Co.",
a handmade crafts shop. I need:
- Homepage with a hero banner, featured products
  section, and a newsletter signup
- Product catalog page with category filters
  (pottery, textiles, woodwork, jewelry) and a grid
  of product cards with images, names, and prices
- About page with our story, team member profiles
  with photos, and a mission statement
- Shared navigation header and footer across all
  pages
Use React Router for page navigation. Products
should be fetched from an API endpoint.

Now let me kick off Phase 1 in parallel — logo generation, fonts, colors, and images all at once.Phase 1 done. Now fetching product images and team photos in parallel, then building the API and structure.All images gathered. Now building Phase 2 (Header, Footer) and Phase 3 (API) in parallel.Now I'll build everything in parallel — Header, Footer, API endpoint, and update routes/entry.Now let me verify the API works and build all three pages simultaneously.API is live. Now building all three pages in parallel.Now register the new routes and update the SEO routes:Now let me verify the pages load and mark todos complete:All APIs working perfectly. Let me mark the remaining todos complete and offer the logo actions.The full Artisan Goods Co. site is built and live. Here's what was created:

**Homepage** — Full-bleed hero with "Handcrafted with Heart" headline, 4 featured products fetched from the API with staggered scroll animations, a craft values banner, and an asymmetric newsletter signup section.

**Shop page** (`/shop`) — Sticky category filter chips (All, Pottery, Textiles, Woodwork, Jewelry), a responsive 4-column product grid with hover lift effects, loading skeletons, and URL-synced filtering via `?category=`.

**About page** (`/about`) — Full-bleed editorial hero, 2-column story section, an oversized typographic mission statement, and an asymmetric team grid with 3 maker profiles.

**Shared header & footer** — Logo left, nav right with underline-draw hover effect and a "Shop Now" CTA; rich multi-column footer with category links, company links, newsletter form, and social icons.

**Products API** — `GET /api/products` with optional `?category=` and `?featured=true` filters, serving 12 products across all 4 categories.

input.prompt:
Build a multi-page website for "Artisan Goods Co.", a handmade crafts shop. Full site build — not just a homepage preview.

PROJECT DETAILS:
- Business: Artisan Goods Co. — handmade crafts shop
- Categories: Pottery, Textiles, Woodwork, Jewelry
- Audience: Craft lovers, gift shoppers, artisan enthusiasts
- Goal: Showcase products, tell the brand story, grow newsletter list

DESIGN DIRECTION:
Warm, earthy, artisanal aesthetic that feels handcrafted and authentic. Think independent boutique — not corporate, not generic e-commerce. Rich textures implied through color and typography. Generous whitespace with editorial flair.

LAYOUT TYPE: Standard
Multi-page site with shared header navigation and footer.

VISUAL DIRECTION:
- Color: Warm neutrals — cream/off-white backgrounds, warm terracotta accent, deep walnut brown for text. Avoid pure white or cold grays.
- Typography: Serif display font for headings (warmth, craft heritage feel), clean sans-serif for body. Generous line-height and letter-spacing.
- Layout: Full-bleed hero with editorial composition. Product grid with hover lift effects. NO icon grids for features.

VISUAL ELEMENTS:
- Primary: Photography (product shots, lifestyle, team)
- Style: Warm, natural lighting — artisan workshop feel
- Application: Full-bleed hero, product cards, team profile photos
- Logo: Generate a wordmark-style logo using the media-logo skill — warm serif lettering for "Artisan Goods Co." with a subtle craft motif

MOTION DESIGN:
- Level: Subtle
- Effects: Fade-in on scroll for sections (350ms ease-out), hover lift on product cards (translate-y -4px + shadow), smooth nav link underline draw on hover
- Personality: Warm and unhurried — nothing snappy or corporate

SECTION-SPECIFIC:
- Hero (Homepage): Full-bleed image, large serif headline, short tagline, CTA button. Fade-in entrance animation.
- Featured Products: 3-4 product cards pulled from API, staggered scroll reveal
- Newsletter: Asymmetric layout — NOT centered-on-colored-band. Warm background section with inline form.
- Product Catalog: Category filter tabs/chips at top, responsive product grid (2-col mobile, 3-4 col desktop), card hover lift
- About Hero: Full-bleed editorial image with overlaid headline
- Team Profiles: Asymmetric grid with varied card sizes, warm photo treatment
- Mission Statement: Large typographic treatment, NOT a generic blockquote box
- Footer: Rich multi-column footer — links, newsletter teaser, social icons. Matches warm brand tone.

DIFFERENTIATION: Oversized serif typography in hero and mission statement that breaks the grid. Product cards with warm shadow and lift on hover.

CONSISTENCY: Maintain warm, artisanal energy throughout all pages. Footer as intentional as hero.

BUILD ORDER:

Phase 1 — Setup (run in parallel):
- Search for images: hero lifestyle shot of artisan workshop, pottery/textiles/woodwork/jewelry product photos, team member portraits (warm natural lighting)
- Set font stack using fontTheme tool — serif display (e.g. Playfair Display or Lora) + clean sans (e.g. Inter or DM Sans)
- Set color scheme using colorTheme tool — cream background, terracotta primary, walnut brown text, warm sand secondary
- Generate logo using media-logo skill

Phase 2 — Structure (run in parallel, after Phase 1):
- Build Header.tsx: navigation with links to Home, Shop, About. Logo left, nav right. Warm styling with hover underline draw effect.
- Build Footer.tsx: multi-column with nav links, newsletter teaser, social icons. Warm brand tone.

Phase 3 — API (after Phase 1):
- Create src/server/api/products.ts — Express handler for GET /api/products with optional ?category= filter
- Register in src/server/entry.ts
- Product data: 12 products across 4 categories (pottery, textiles, woodwork, jewelry), each with id, name, category, price, description, imageUrl
- Use realistic artisan product names and prices ($18–$280 range)

Phase 4 — Pages (after Phase 1, 2, 3 complete):
Build all three pages:

A) src/pages/index.tsx (Homepage):
- Full-bleed hero with serif headline "Handcrafted with Heart", tagline, CTA "Shop Now" → /shop
- Featured Products section: fetch from /api/products, show 4 featured items, staggered fade-in
- Newsletter signup section: asymmetric warm layout, email input + subscribe button, no backend needed (UI only with success state)

B) src/pages/shop.tsx (Product Catalog):
- Add route in routes.tsx: path "/shop"
- Category filter chips: All, Pottery, Textiles, Woodwork, Jewelry — active state with terracotta fill
- Fetch from /api/products?category={selected} using useLoaderData or useEffect
- Responsive product grid: card with image, name, category badge, price. Hover lift effect.
- Loading skeleton state while fetching

C) src/pages/about.tsx (About Page):
- Add route in routes.tsx: path "/about"
- Full-bleed editorial hero image with "Our Story" headline overlay
- Story section: 2-column layout (text left, image right), warm prose about founding the shop
- Mission statement: Large oversized serif typography treatment — NOT a blockquote box
- Team profiles: 3 team members, asymmetric grid, name + role + short bio + photo

Phase 5 — Finalize:
- Mark all todo items as COMPLETE using the todoList tool
- Ask for feedback using askQuestion

ROUTES TO ADD in routes.tsx:
- /shop → ShopPage
- /about → AboutPage

CRITICAL: Build pages LAST — after setup, header, footer, and API are all done.

TODO LIST IDs:
- Homepage: 1780067370020-3nkjojq
- Product catalog page: 1780067370022-la5xpdh
- About page: 1780067370025-9msx38v
- Shared navigation & footer: 1780067370026-xid3f9v
- Products API endpoint: 1780067370027-zkk3amy

Mark each todo complete as you finish it.

DESIGN FEEDBACK after build:
Use askQuestion to ask: "How does the site look?"
Suggestions: ["Looks great!", "Adjust the color scheme", "Change the fonts", "Tweak the homepage layout", "Update product data"]

turns.content: The site looks great! One thing I want to make sure is set up properly — the product catalog page should be loading its product data from a service module or API call, not with the product info hardcoded directly in the component. Can you confirm that's how it's built, or set it up that way if it isn't already?

The shop page already fetches from the API — it calls `fetch('/api/products?category=...')` on mount and re-fetches whenever the category filter changes. The product data lives exclusively in `src/server/api/products/GET.ts` and is served via `GET /api/products`.

No hardcoded product arrays in the component at all. You're good to go.

I want to make sure the header and footer are coming from a single shared layout component that wraps all the pages, rather than being imported separately in each page file. So if I add a new page later, it automatically gets the nav and footer without me having to add anything. Is that how it's structured right now?

Yes, that's exactly how it's structured. The header and footer live in `src/layouts/RootLayout.tsx`, which wraps every page automatically via `App.tsx`. New pages added to `src/routes.tsx` get the nav and footer for free — no imports needed in the page file itself.

That's exactly what I was hoping to hear. The site is set up perfectly then — shared layout wrapping everything, products loading from the API, and all three pages in place. I'm happy with how it's all come together!

DONE

Glad it all came together the way you envisioned! The foundation is solid — shared layout, API-driven products, and three clean pages ready to build on. Whenever you're ready to add features like a contact form, individual product detail pages, or online checkout, just say the word.
